fr_html: M. LODER propose la suppression de la dernière partie de l'article 12 du projet Root—Phillimore: si l'on stipule que la Cour nommera son greffier, on aura en même temps dit qu'elle peut nommer qui elle veut et, par conséquent, le greffier de la Cour d'Arbitrage.
en_html: M. LODER proposed that the last part of Article 12 of the Root—Phillimore plan should be deleted. If it were laid down that the Court would appoint its own Registrar, this would imply that it could appoint whomsoever it wished, and consequently, this would include the Registrar of the Court or Arbitration.
